en.bdb: The life of Guru-slanderer is meaningless

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਪਤੁ ਕਰੀਰੁ ਨਾ ਮਉਲੀਐ ਦੇ ਦੋਸੁ ਬਸੰਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: apat kareer naa mauleeaai dhe dhos basa(n)tai|

en.bdb: The leafless wild caper Karin does not grow green but it blames the spring season.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਢਿ ਸਪੁਤੀ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਕਣਤਾਵੈ ਕੰਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)dd saputee naa theeaai kanataavai ka(n)tai|

en.bdb: The barren women does not bear the child but she blames her husband.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਰਿ ਖੇਤੁ ਨਾ ਜੰਮਈ ਘਣਹਰੁ ਵਰਸੰਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: kalar khet naa ja(n)miee ghanahar varasa(n)tai|

en.bdb: The rains of the clouds cannot make alkaline field grow and produce.
The meritorious people get evils and embarrassments in the company of vicious people.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਇਰੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਘੰਘੂਟਿਆਂ ਬਹੁ ਰਤਨ ਅਨੰਤੈ।
verses.translit_en: sair vich gha(n)ghooTiaa(n) bahu ratan ana(n)tai|

en.bdb: In the ocean, one gets many a pearl even from the shells, i.e. the association with the good produces good results.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮ ਗਵਾਇ ਅਕਾਰਥਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗਣਤ ਗਣੰਤੈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit_en: janam gavai akaarathaa gur ganat gana(n)tai ||7||

en.bdb: Slandering the Guru, the whole life elapses in vain.
